description: Find and prove Cross-Site Scripting (reflected, stored, DOM). Load when input is echoed into HTML/JS/attributes, a search/comment/profile field renders your text, a URL param appears in the response, or a sink like innerHTML/document.write is in client JS. Signals: "search=", reflected values, error pages echoing input, Angular/React dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
